limitations: Originality is best-of-knowledge. The theorem settles only the \(r=1\) slice of the stated conjecture; for one residue class it gives a lower bound rather than a complete valuation formula; the finite verifier is auxiliary; the primary preprint full text was not retrievable during this audit.
provenance: A 2-adic boundary-coefficient analysis of the valuation problem for powers of the Thue--Morse series, using the power-of-two valuation theorem and the Thue--Morse functional equation.
record_title: Explicit 2-adic obstructions for all twice-odd powers of the Thue–Morse series
